title: useHits hooks with react instant search and algoliasearch 5.20
body:

comments.body: react-instantsearch-hooks-web v6 is the previous major version. Please update to react-instantsearch v7 first and then you will have all the latest features. The migration should not be that complicated: https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/upgrade-guides/react/#migrate-from-react-instantsearch-hooks-to-react-instantsearch-v7
